title: Embedding a decision tree
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $e:[m]\hookrightarrow[n]$ be an embedding. For finite coordinate sets $S\subseteq[m]$ and $T\subseteq[n]$ such that $e(i)\in T$ for every $i\in S$, every binary decision tree on $[m]$ with available coordinates $S$ induces a binary decision tree on $[n]$ with available coordinates $T$: leaves retain their values, and each query at $i$ becomes a query at $e(i)$, with the two branches embedded recursively.
